neighbours.label: web-browser page navigation context: browser windows and tabs, reloading or redirecting the page's location, the back button
fire: If the user closes the browser window, the session cookie is lost.
Calling window.location.reload forces the browser to fetch the page again.
After login, the server sends a redirect so the browser loads the dashboard.
Hit the refresh button in your browser if the images do not appear.
The app uses history.pushState so the browser back button still works.
In Firefox, opening the same URL in two browser tabs shares one session.
Set document.location to the new address to navigate away from the form.
Please use your browser's back arrow to return to the search results.
quiet: If the user closes the laptop lid, the battery saver turns on.
Calling json.loads parses the string into a Python dictionary.
After login, the server writes a row to the audit table.
Hit the power button on your printer if the lights do not appear.
The app uses a SQLite database so the offline mode still works.
In Excel, opening the same file on two computers locks one copy.
Set the font size to fourteen points to make the form readable.
Please use a blue or black pen to fill out the paper form.
